changes: Added a mechanical classifier for post-implementation descendants: material changes require a new implementation head, while task-local evidence-only descendants leave certification bound to the existing implementation head.
Hardened Project Leader and Recovery Guardian contracts so automatic CI on evidence-only descendants is non-certifying and cannot by itself reopen task Recovery or create recursive evidence/CI loops.
Separated optional/required final-head repository-governance checks from task certification semantics.
Hardened interrupted external-CI recovery: if chat state is lost before exact wait IDs are captured, reconstruct existing runs from live task/SHA/PR/workflow evidence before any dispatch.
Added executable unit and contract tests for the reproduced PINK IPTV behavior.

validation.evidence: Required implementation CI completed successfully on exact implementation head c359fa1ddf84e1cfa0dae03f6d1e136fe07e0af3; final descendants contain only task-local transition/result evidence permitted by the canonical verifier.

validation.evidence: Exact Owner-authorized trust-root transition was persisted before protected contract/plugin/control mutations and its SUCCESS result was persisted after the implementation-head CI passed.

validation.evidence: New classify_post_implementation_descendant tests prove evidence-only descendants route CERTIFICATION_UNCHANGED unless repository governance requires FINAL_HEAD_GOVERNANCE_CHECK; material descendants route FRESH_IMPLEMENTATION_CI.

validation.evidence: Canonical and packaged recovery contracts now require reconstruction of existing exact runs from durable live state when interruption occurs before wait IDs were captured; missing chat state never authorizes replacement CI.

No release, deploy, secret, destructive, paid-service or infrastructure effect.
No weakening of existing CI, trusted-gate or evidence requirements.
